Description Shaping the future together – your apprenticeship at Endress+Hauser International AG

Around 18,000 employees work at Endress+Hauser worldwide and develop, build and improve measuring instruments that are used all over the world.

At Endress+Hauser International AG you don't just work anywhere – you are part of a global sales organization that supports customers in over 80 countries and successfully distributes a broad product portfolio through an international partner network.

What is important to us? Cooperation, trust and team spirit. Together we achieve more – and every idea counts. As a family-run company, we think in the long term and invest in your future. We not only provide you with top training, but also many opportunities to develop yourself further, also internationally, and to help shape it.

What's the job about?

You are interested in economic relationships, like to work on the computer and want to get to know different commercial areas? Then the training as a merchant or an EFZ at Endress+Hauser is just right for you!

During your training, you work in different departments such as HR management, financial accounting, purchasing, marketing or order processing. You perform administrative tasks, maintain internal and external contacts and learn to use digital tools in a targeted manner.

Tasks - independently perform commercial activities - take responsibility for smaller projects - maintain contact with customers, customers and partners at international level - apply modern tools of the digital world of work - work in different departments and get diverse insights

Requirements - are in middle or upper school level - achieves good performance in the language subjects (English is a prerequisite) and in mathematics - think connected and interested in business topics - have a broad general education and work on the computer - are careful, team-oriented and reliable - have fun working with people from other cultures

descriptionByLocale.de:
Gemeinsam Zukunft gestalten – deine Lehre bei Endress+Hauser International AG

Weltweit arbeiten bei Endress+Hauser rund 18.000 Mitarbeitenden und entwickeln, bauen und verbessern Messgeräte, die auf der ganzen Welt zum Einsatz kommen.

Bei Endress+Hauser International AG arbeitest du nicht einfach irgendwo – du bist Teil einer globalen Salesorganisation, die Kunden in über 80 Ländern betreut und ein breites Produktportfolio erfolgreich über ein internationales Partnernetzwerk vertreibt.

Was uns dabei wichtig ist? Zusammenarbeit, Vertrauen und Teamgeist. Denn gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr – und jede Idee zählt. Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen denken wir langfristig und investieren in deine Zukunft. Bei uns bekommst du nicht nur eine top Ausbildung, sondern auch viele Chancen, dich weiterzuentwickeln, auch international, und mitzugestalten.

Worum geht es bei der Stelle?

Du interessierst dich für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, arbeitest gerne am Computer und möchtest unterschiedliche kaufmännische Bereiche kennenlernen?
Dann ist die Ausbildung zur Kauffrau oder zum Kaufmann EFZ bei Endress+Hauser genau das Richtige für dich!

Während deiner Ausbildung arbeitest du in verschiedenen Abteilungen wie z. B. Personalmanagement, Finanzbuchhaltung, Einkauf, Marketing oder Auftragsabwicklung. Du ü bernimmst administrative Aufgaben, betreust interne wie externe Kontakte und lernst, digitale Tools gezielt einzusetzen.

Welche Aufgaben wirst du übernehmen?

Du wirst

• selbständig kaufmännische Tätigkeiten ausführen

• Verantwortung für kleinere Projekte übernehmen

• Kontakt zu Kundinnen, Kunden und Partnern auf internationaler Ebene pflegen

• moderne Tools der digitalen Arbeitswelt anwenden

• in verschiedenen Abteilungen mitarbeiten und vielseitige Einblicke erhalten

Was erwarten wir von dir?

Du

• bist in der mittleren oder oberen Schulstufe

• erzielst gute Leistungen in den sprachlichen Fächern (Englisch ist Voraussetzung) und in Mathematik

• denkst vernetzt und interessierst dich für Wirtschaftsthemen

• verfügst über eine breite Allgemeinbildung und arbeitest gerne am Computer

• bist sorgfältig, teamorientiert und zuverlässig

• hast Spass daran, mit Menschen aus anderen Kulturen zusammenzuarbeiten

Was kannst du von uns erwarten?

• Sicherheit und Stabilität eines international tätigen Familienunternehmens

• Sehr gute Übernahmechancen nach der Ausbildung

• Ein motiviertes und engagiertes Ausbildungsteam, das dich begleitet

• Kostenübernahme des U-Abos (ÖV)

• Leckere und günstige Mittagsmenüs ab 5.50 CHF im firmeneigenen Restaurant

Für deine Bewerbung benötigen wir:

• Motivationsschreiben

• Lebenslauf

• Alle Zeugnisse der Sekundarstufe 1

• Multicheck berufsspezifisch oder S2-Check mit Auswertung im Berufsfeld

Für Fragen stehen wir dir gerne unter: info.int@endress.com oder unter +41 61 715 8140 zur Verfügung.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Description Comment façonner l'avenir ensemble – votre apprentissage chez Endress+Hauser International AG

Environ 18 000 employés travaillent chez Endress+Hauser dans le monde entier et développent, construisent et améliorent des instruments de mesure utilisés dans le monde entier.

Chez Endress+Hauser International AG, vous ne travaillez pas seulement n'importe où – vous faites partie d'une organisation de vente mondiale qui soutient les clients dans plus de 80 pays et distribue avec succès un large portefeuille de produits grâce à un réseau de partenaires internationaux.

Ce qui est important pour nous? Coopération, confiance et esprit d'équipe. Ensemble, nous obtenons plus – et chaque idée compte. En tant qu'entreprise familiale, nous pensons à long terme et investissons dans votre avenir. Nous vous offrons non seulement une formation supérieure, mais aussi de nombreuses occasions de vous développer davantage, aussi à l'échelle internationale, et de l'aider à le façonner.

C'est quoi le boulot?

Vous êtes intéressé par les relations économiques, comme travailler sur l'ordinateur et voulez apprendre à connaître différentes zones commerciales? Ensuite la formation en tant que marchand ou EFZ chez Endress+Hauser est juste pour vous!

Pendant votre formation, vous travaillez dans différents départements comme la gestion des RH, la comptabilité financière, l'achat, le marketing ou le traitement des commandes. Vous effectuez des tâches administratives, maintenez des contacts internes et externes et apprenez à utiliser les outils numériques de manière ciblée.

Tâches - mener des activités commerciales de façon indépendante - prendre en charge des projets de moindre envergure - maintenir le contact avec les clients, les clients et les partenaires au niveau international - appliquer les outils modernes du monde du travail numérique - travailler dans différents départements et obtenir des informations diverses

Les exigences - sont au niveau moyen ou supérieur - atteignent de bons résultats dans les matières linguistiques (l'anglais est une condition préalable) et en mathématiques - pensent connecté et intéressé par les sujets d'affaires - ont une large éducation générale et travaillent sur l'ordinateur - sont prudents, orientés par l'équipe et fiables - ont plaisir à travailler avec des gens d'autres cultures

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Endress+ Hauser, i progressi sono fatti attraverso la collaborazione. Come fornitore leader mondiale di strumenti di misura, i nostri oltre 18.000 dipendenti stanno plasmando il futuro dell'automazione dei processi. Che si sviluppino nuove tecnologie, utilizzino soluzioni innovative o lavorino con diverse industrie globali, il nostro lavoro si basa su relazioni di fiducia che aiutano tutti ad avere successo. Come azienda a conduzione familiare, guardiamo oltre gli obiettivi a breve termine e creiamo un futuro sostenibile per i nostri dipendenti, i nostri clienti e la società.

Siamo alla ricerca di un architetto di sistema* in Ingegneria Elettrica e Processo (m/f/d) per integrare il nostro team e per proteggere in futuro l'architettura tecnica dei nostri impianti e attrezzature. Bei Endress+Hauser geschieht Fortschritt durch Zusammenarbeit. Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen schauen wir über kurzfristige Ziele hinaus und arbeiten daran, eine zukunftsorientierte Vision für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kund:innen und die Welt im Allgemeinen zu schaffen.

Worum geht es bei der Rolle?

Wir suchen einen Schichtleiter*in für die Kundenfertigung, die/der unser globales Team mit Fachkompetenz und Führungsstärke ergänzt. Sie übernehmen Verantwortung in der Fertigung, gestalten Prozesse aktiv mit und stellen sicher, dass unser hoher Qualitätsanspruch täglich umgesetzt wird.

Welche Aufgaben werden Sie übernehmen?

• Sie führen eine Schicht mit 10–13 Mitarbeitenden im 2-Schicht-Betrieb und entwickeln Ihr Team gezielt weiter.

• Sie planen, koordinieren und steuern das Tagesgeschäft, um die gesetzten Ziele effizient zu erreichen.

• Sie setzen Qualitätsvorgaben, Sicherheitsrichtlinien und interne Standards konsequent um und fördern deren Einhaltung.

• Sie initiieren kontinuierliche Verbesserungsprozesse (Kaizen) und setzen diese gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team um.

• Sie verantworten den Bereich Autonomous Maintenance im Rahmen unserer TPM-Strategie und agieren direkt auf dem Shopfloor als Vorbild.

Was erwarten wir von Ihnen?

• Sie verfügen über eine technische Grundausbildung sowie eine Weiterbildung als Führungsfachfrau/-mann, Meisterin oder Technikerin.

• Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung im technischen Umfeld mit und setzen Ihr Know-how gezielt ein.

• Sie sind kommunikativ, organisiert und begeistern sich dafür, Menschen zu fördern und weiterzuentwickeln.

• Sie sind sicher im Umgang mit MS Office und SAP und haben idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit LEAN-Methoden.

• Sie beherrschen die deutsche Sprache sicher in Wort und Schrift und bringen zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse idealerweise mit, arbeiten selbständig, flexibel und teamorientiert.

Was können Sie von uns erwarten?

• Wir sind ein familiengeführtes, engagiertes Unternehmen mit einer nachhaltigen Vision.

• Wir fördern lebenslanges Lernen mit vielseitigen Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, internem Wissenstransfer und E-Learning.

• Wir unterstützen Work-Life-Balance mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.

• Wir bieten Unterstützung bei nachhaltigen Mobilitätslösungen wie öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln.

• Wir unterstützen familienfreundliche Richtlinien, einschliesslich Kinderbetreuungsplätze und Kinderbetreuungsdienste während der Ferien.

Wie bewerben Sie sich?

Um sich zu bewerben, bitten wir Sie, Ihre Unterlagen auf unserer Karriereseite hochzuladen. Bewerbungen, die uns per E-Mail zugesandt werden, können leider aus Datenschutzgründen nicht berücksichtigt werden.

Derzeit arbeiten wir für diese Stelle nicht mit externen Dienstleistern zusammen. Alle unaufgeforderten Bewerbungen von Dienstleistern werden nicht berücksichtigt und ohne weitere Prüfung gelöscht. Wir bedanken uns für Ihr Verständnis.

Que ce soit l'innovation et la mise en œuvre de nouvelles technologies dans une équipe, la collaboration pour développer de nouveaux appareils ou le renforcement de relations importantes avec différentes industries mondiales, notre travail est basé sur l'établissement de relations de confiance qui aident chacun à réussir. Adresse+ Hauser Flowtec AG in Reinach développe et produit des débitmètres utilisés dans le monde entier. Groupe Hauser.

De quoi s'agit-il ?

Vous aimez travailler quotidiennement avec des clients et des inspecteurs du monde entier?

Conservez-vous un aperçu même si plusieurs rendez-vous, ordres et exigences doivent être coordonnés en même temps?

Vous sentez-vous à l'aise dans un rôle où le talent organisationnel, la communication et l'orientation du service sont cruciaux?

Quelles tâches allez-vous entreprendre?

Qu'attendons-nous de vous ?

titleByLocale.en: Team Lead, Digitalization & Integration Projects (MVP) - m/f/d

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, with over 18,000 employees, we shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with countless global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.

We are looking for a Team Lead, Digitalization & Integration Projects to join Endress+Hauser Digital Solutions and lead a team of five professionals in delivering digitalization and integration projects that create tangible value for our customers. Based in Reinach, Switzerland, Digital Solutions is Endress+Hauser Group’s Product Center for Industrial Internet of Things, digitalization, digital communication, integration, Plant Asset Management and digital solutions, helping process industries unlock the value of connected technologies and data.

What is the role about?

Are you an experienced leader who enjoys combining technology, customer needs and commercial opportunities? Do you have the drive to turn digital solutions into successful customer projects? Can you build strong relationships across Sales Centers, Product Centers and Business Development while developing a high-performing team?

As Team Lead, Digitalization & Integration Projects, you will lead a team of five professionals and take responsibility for the technical, commercial and operational direction of project-based Digital Solutions offerings. You will help identify new opportunities, strengthen collaboration across the Endress+Hauser Group and develop scalable ways of delivering digital solutions. This is a hands-on leadership role where your ability to combine project expertise, business understanding and people leadership will contribute directly to the growth of Digital Solutions.

Which tasks will you perform?

You will:

• Lead and develop a team of five professionals, coaching project leaders and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and professional growth.

• Build trusted relationships with Sales Centers, Product Centers, Business Development and other internal stakeholders to align customer needs, opportunities and project execution.

• Drive commercial growth by managing the project pipeline, supporting acquisitions and quotations, and contributing to order intake and strategic customer opportunities.

• Own the technical and commercial direction of project-based Digital Solutions offerings, ensuring solutions are customer-focused, scalable, profitable and aligned with business strategy.

• Identify opportunities to expand repeatable solution offerings by addressing portfolio gaps and developing reusable frameworks, templates and delivery models.

• Drive operational excellence by improving processes, establishing clear ways of working and using relevant KPIs to increase efficiency, transparency and delivery quality.

What do we expect from you?

You:

• Bring proven experience in leading, coaching and developing high-performing teams in project management, business development, digital solutions or a comparable environment.

• Have a strong understanding of Industrial IoT solutions, digital architectures and process automation technologies, including technologies such as HART, PROFIBUS, PROFINET, WirelessHART and APL.

• Combine technical understanding with strong commercial and solution-oriented business acumen, connecting customer needs, technical decisions, project execution and business objectives.

• Are entrepreneurial and growth-oriented, with a hands-on approach and a strong drive to identify opportunities and deliver measurable business impact.

• Build effective relationships and communicate confidently across functions, cultures and decision levels within an international and global matrix organization.

• Are adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating complexity and change while remaining focused on delivering results and continuously developing your knowledge.

• Have experience with sales enablement and project management tools such as Salesforce and Planview.

• Have strong English skills; additional languages are an advantage, and you are willing to travel as required by the role.

What can you expect from us?

• A dynamic and innovative work environment at the forefront of digital transformation.

• A flexible and family-friendly work culture that supports work-life balance.

• Competitive salary and benefits package, including health and wellness programs.

• The security and prospects of an international, family-owned company that supports sustainability and diversity and has a long-term vision.

• We promote lifelong learning and provide opportunities to develop your expertise, share knowledge and grow professionally.

• You will work in an international environment where collaboration across teams, products and locations is central to how we develop technology.

• You will have the opportunity to influence our technology direction and help build the capabilities, standards and ways of working that support sustainable growth.

How do you apply?

To apply we kindly ask you to upload your documents on our career page. Applications sent to us by E-Mail can unfortunately not be considered due to Data Privacy Considerations.

Agencies, HR service providers, or similar entities are kindly requested to refrain from unsolicited submission of profiles and inquiries regarding potential collaboration. Currently, we do not engage with external service providers for this role. Any unsolicited applications will be disregarded and deleted without further consideration. We appreciate your understanding.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Formare insieme il futuro – il vostro insegnamento a Endress+ Hauser
A Endress+ Hauser, non si lavora solo da nessuna parte – si fa parte di un team che lavora su tecnologie emozionanti per l'industria in tutto il mondo. I nostri circa 18.000 dipendenti sviluppano, costruiscono e migliorano gli strumenti di misura utilizzati in tutto il mondo. Collaborazione, fiducia e spirito di squadra. Perché insieme raggiungiamo di più – e ogni idea conta. Come azienda a conduzione familiare, pensiamo a lungo termine e investiamo nel vostro futuro. Con noi non solo si ottiene un'istruzione superiore, ma anche molte opportunità per sviluppare e modellarsi.

Qual è il punto?
Hai una buona immaginazione? Sei interessato alla tecnologia, alle macchine e a come vengono costruite le cose? E ti piace lavorare sul computer con i moderni programmi 3D?
Poi l'allenamento come costruttore* in EFZ è giusto per voi!

In questa formazione, si sviluppa e costruisce dispositivi meccanici, elettrici ed elettronici, macchine e impianti. Si lavora con un moderno sistema CAD, creare disegni tecnici e tradurre idee in piani precisi che vengono utilizzati per la produzione. Lavorate a stretto contatto con i reparti di sviluppo e produzione.

Quali compiti assumerai?

Lo farai:

• Modellazione e progettazione di attrezzature meccaniche, elettriche ed elettroniche, macchinari e attrezzature

• Disegni di componenti e sotto-assemblaggi per disegni di progettazione, fabbricazione o montaggio

• Adapt e ottimizzare i disegni tecnici esistenti

• Elaborazione di costruzioni dettagliate utilizzando il sistema CAD

Cosa ci aspettiamo da te?
Tu...

• sono a scuola media o superiore

• Mostra buone prestazioni in matematica, design tecnico e fisica

• porta la comprensione delle connessioni astratte e tecniche

• avere buone capacità di pensiero logico e analitico

• Lavorare con attenzione, concentrati e sono team capaci

Cosa puoi aspettarti da noi?

• Sicurezza e stabilità di un business familiare operativo a livello internazionale

• Molto buone opportunità di acquisizione dopo l'allenamento

• Un team di formazione motivato e dedicato che vi accompagnerà

• Costi dell'U-Subscription (Pubblico)

• Menù deliziosi e economici a partire da 5,50 CHF nel ristorante dell'azienda

Per la vostra applicazione abbiamo bisogno di:

• Lettera di motivazione

• CVC

• Tutti i certificati di istruzione secondaria superiore

• S2-Check con valutazione in campo professionale e/o multicheck

Applichi subito.

•

descriptionByLocale.en:
Shaping the future together – your teaching at Endress+Hauser
At Endress+Hauser, you don’t just work anywhere – you are part of a team working on exciting technologies for industry worldwide. Our approximately 18,000 employees develop, build and improve measuring instruments that are used all over the world. Collaboration, trust and team spirit. Because together we achieve more – and every idea counts. As a family-run company, we think long-term and invest in your future. With us you not only get a top education, but also many opportunities to develop and shape yourself.

What is the point about?
Do you have a good imagination? Are you interested in technology, machines and how things are constructed? And do you like working on the computer with modern 3D programs?
Then training as a constructor*in EFZ is just right for you!

In this training, you develop and construct mechanical, electrical and electronic devices, machines and plants. You work with a modern CAD system, create technical drawings and translate ideas into precise plans that are used for production. You work closely with development and production departments.

What tasks will you take on?

You will:

• Modelling and designing mechanical, electrical and electronic equipment, machinery and equipment

• Drawings of components and sub-assemblies by design, manufacture or assembly drawings

• Adapt and optimize existing technical drawings

• Working out detailed constructions using CAD system

What do we expect from you?
You:

• are in middle or upper school

• Shows good performance in mathematics, technical design and physics

• brings understanding of abstract and technical connections

• have good logical and analytical thinking skills

• Work carefully, focused and are team capable

What can you expect from us?

• Security and stability of an internationally operating family business

• Very good takeover opportunities after training

• A motivated and dedicated training team that will accompany you

• Costs of the U-Subscription (Public)

• Delicious and cheap lunch menus from 5.50 CHF in the company's restaurant

For your application we need:

• Letter of motivation

• CVC

• All upper secondary education certificates

• S2-Check with evaluation in the professional field and/or multicheck

Apply now.

A Endress+ Hauser, i progressi sono fatti attraverso la collaborazione. Come fornitore leader mondiale di strumenti di misura, i nostri oltre 18.000 dipendenti stanno plasmando il futuro nel campo dell’automazione dei processi. Che si tratti di innovare e implementare nuove tecnologie in un team, lavorare insieme per sviluppare nuovi dispositivi, o rafforzare relazioni importanti con diverse industrie globali, il nostro lavoro si basa sulla costruzione di relazioni di fiducia che aiutano tutti ad avere successo. Come azienda a conduzione familiare, guardiamo oltre gli obiettivi a breve termine e lavoriamo per creare una visione orientata al futuro per i nostri dipendenti, i nostri clienti e il mondo in generale.

Stiamo cercando un dipendente nella produzione di sensori (m/f/d) per integrare il nostro team e dare un importante contributo alla produzione dei nostri flussimetri Coriolis. In questo ruolo, si garantisce con la vostra consapevolezza di qualità e la cura che i nostri prodotti soddisfano i più elevati standard. Endress+ Hauser Flow sviluppa e produce contatori di flusso innovativi per i clienti in tutto il mondo nella sua posizione a Reinach. Insieme creiamo soluzioni che danno un importante contributo alla sicurezza, all'efficienza e alla sostenibilità in una vasta gamma di settori.

Di cosa si tratta?

Ti piace lavorare in un ambiente di produzione moderno? Vuoi rendere visibile ogni giorno precisione e qualità? Apprezzi lavorare insieme in un team consolidato che si assume la responsabilità congiunta di prodotti di alta qualità?

Allora questa posizione potrebbe essere giusta per te. Come parte di un team di circa dieci persone nella produzione di sensori, contribuisce alla produzione di innovativi misuratori di portata Coriolis. La posizione si trova all'interno della produzione di Endress+ Hauser Flow.

Quali compiti assumerai?

Essi:

• Produce contatori di flusso Coriolis come parte di un team di circa dieci

• Caricamento e test di funzionamento, attrezzature di sabbiatura e saldatura

• Valutazione delle saldature e delle superfici in materia di qualità e design

• Lavorare in modo flessibile nel funzionamento a due turni e garantire un processo di produzione regolare

• Mantenere strutture e luoghi di lavoro in ottime condizioni attraverso l'applicazione dei metodi 5S e TPM

• Partecipa attivamente al processo di miglioramento continuo e contribuisce al potenziale di ottimizzazione

Cosa ci aspettiamo da te?

Loro:

• Avere completato l'istruzione di base, idealmente in una professione tecnica

• Portare l'esperienza in un ambiente di produzione

• Avere una forte consapevolezza della qualità, soprattutto quando si valutano le superfici

• Idealmente avere esperienza negli impianti di produzione operativi

• Idealmente avere esperienza nella valutazione delle saldature

• Padroneggiare bene la lingua tedesca nella parola e nella scrittura e sono caratterizzati da flessibilità, responsabilità personale, volontà di imparare e spirito di squadra

Cosa puoi aspettarti da noi?

• Siamo un'azienda a conduzione familiare con grande impegno e una visione sostenibile

At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, with over 18,000 employees, we shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with our global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.

We are looking for an Assistant to join us and provide high-level administrative and strategic support to the advisory functions of the CEO at Endress+Hauser Group Services AG. In this role, you will be part of our Group’s global headquarters in Reinach, Switzerland, supporting the Teams Corporate Communication, Internal Audit and Enterprise Development.

What is the role about?

Are you organized, proactive, and comfortable managing a wide range of executive-level responsibilities? Do you thrive on creating structure in an international environment? Are you skilled at anticipating needs and finding solutions before others notice the challenge?

If so, this role is your opportunity to play a vital part in supporting our global leadership. You’ll work directly with the CEO and his teams, coordinating across international teams — ensuring the smooth execution of operational and administrative activities within a dynamic and collaborative corporate environment.

Which tasks will you perform?

You will:

• Assist the three advisory teams of the CEO in all aspects of their administrative, commercial, and relational tasks, both internally and externally.

• Proactively manage the agendas in the short- and medium-term, organizing and coordinating meetings, trips, and events in alignment with other Executive Board members.

• Manage correspondence by prioritizing and responding to emails, ensuring timely communication and efficient information flow.

• Coordinate all travel arrangements, including bookings, documentation, and schedules, ensuring all details are prepared well in advance.

• Support in reporting activities by collecting data from various sources, creating source documents, and preparing monthly reports based on business process system analysis.

• Collaborate closely with other assistants and corporate teams to ensure smooth communication and event organization.

What do we expect from you?

You:

• Hold a degree or equivalent education as an Executive Assistant.

• Are fluent in both German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Bring proven experience supporting executives in an international environment, ideally with a track record of supporting multiple teams simultaneously.

• Demonstrate excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, with a high level of professionalism and discretion in handling confidential information.

• Are proficient with Microsoft 365 and modern collaboration tools. Familiarity with business systems such as SAP Business Warehouse and AI tools is an advantage.

• Have a strong digital mindset, curiosity for new tools and the ability to quickly learn and apply new software are essential.

• Show strong self-management, initiative, and the ability to work independently while being a collaborative team player.

• Are curious, adaptable, and motivated to continuously improve processes and expand your knowledge.

What can you expect from us?

• We are a family-owned, highly committed company with a sustainable vision.

• We promote lifelong learning with versatile training and further education opportunities, internal knowledge transfer, and e-learning.

• We prioritize employee well-being by offering a comprehensive company pension scheme and access to health offers that support our employees’ overall wellness.

How do you apply?

To apply, we kindly ask you to upload your documents on our career page. Applications sent to us by email can unfortunately not be considered due to data privacy considerations.

Descrizione
In Endress+Hauser il progresso avviene attraverso la collaborazione. In qualità di fornitore leader mondiale di strumenti di misura, i nostri oltre 18.000 dipendenti stanno plasmando il futuro nel campo dell'automazione dei processi. Che si tratti di innovare e implementare nuove tecnologie in team, di collaborare allo sviluppo di nuovi dispositivi o di rafforzare relazioni chiave con vari settori globali, il nostro lavoro si basa sulla costruzione di relazioni di fiducia che aiutano tutti ad avere successo. Essendo un’azienda a conduzione familiare, guardiamo oltre gli obiettivi a breve termine e lavoriamo per creare una visione orientata al futuro per i nostri dipendenti, i nostri clienti e il mondo in generale.

Cerchiamo un ingegnere dell'automazione (software e connettività della macchina) al 100% (m/f/d) che pensi insieme al software della macchina (PLC) e alla connettività della macchina e garantisca che i requisiti siano chiari, testabili e conformi agli standard nella loro implementazione.

Alla Flowtec AG di Reinach, come centro di prodotto, sviluppiamo tecnologie di misurazione della portata e soluzioni per l'automazione dei processi. Nella nostra sede di Reinach lavorano circa 1.600 collaboratori di oltre 52 nazionalità. Endress+Hauser Flowtech AG è rappresentata in sei sedi in tutto il mondo con oltre 2.900 dipendenti.

Di cosa tratta la posizione?

Non vuoi solo “cercare errori”, ma vuoi anche ancorare la qualità nelle prime fasi del ciclo di vita? Comprendi i processi delle macchine, la logica PLC e la connettività (incluso OPC UA), sai strutturare chiaramente i requisiti e, insieme a partner esterni, puoi mettere in funzione in modo affidabile un'ampia gamma di sistemi di macchine? Allora sei nel posto giusto: in questo ruolo combinerai lo sviluppo del software, l'ingegneria dei requisiti per il software della macchina e l'ingegneria della connettività della macchina. Dalla specifica al FAT/SAT e alla messa in servizio.

Compiti
Potrai:

- Strutturare e specificare i requisiti: collaborare con specialisti, operatori e gestione del progetto su software e processi per macchine (sotto forma di modelli di stato, definizioni di interfacce, specifiche di comando, gestione di errori/eccezioni, flussi di sequenze e processi, definizioni di limiti e gestione dei test)
- Condurre revisioni in loco, intraprendere debugging e aggiustamenti selettivi o supporto prototipi del software della macchina con supporto durante l'intero ciclo di vita dei prodotti e delle macchine
- Sviluppare modelli standard OPC UA e modelli informativi per l'integrazione delle macchine, mantenerli coerenti, rivedere professionalmente le implementazioni dei fornitori e verificare la conformità agli standard, inclusa la mappatura e l'integrazione
- Guidare professionalmente i produttori di macchine esterne: impostare e richiedere allineamenti, revisioni e QMS
- Pianificare, eseguire e documentare FAT/SAT e test di integrazione, nonché gestire cicli di correzione iterativi con i fornitori
- Garantire stabilità end-to-end e barriere di sicurezza OT (certificati, policy, protezione degli accessi, gate di qualità, documentazione)

Requisiti
Tu:

- Possedere una laurea o un master in tecnologia dell'automazione, ingegneria dei sistemi, ingegneria elettrica o una qualifica equivalente
- Avere esperienza nello sviluppo di PLC secondo la norma IEC 61131-3 e comprendere molto bene l'automazione, la logica del PLC e i processi delle macchine con sequenze, stati e modelli di errore
- Avere esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di concetti PLC e nell'architettura di sistemi PLC, idealmente con macchine a stati, modalità operative, test e risoluzione dei problemi strutturata
- Lavorare nell'ingegneria dei requisiti in modo strutturato, testabile e orientato agli obiettivi e idealmente avere esperienza nell'ambiente macchina o OT
- Avere know-how in OPC UA, comunicazione industriale e modellazione di interfacce, nonché esperienza in FAT/SAT e nella gestione tecnica dei fornitori
- Comunica con sicurezza in tedesco e inglese e divertiti a lavorare in tutti i reparti con costruzioni elettriche e meccaniche, nonché con altri partecipanti al progetto

Offriamo
- Siamo un'azienda a conduzione familiare con grande impegno e una visione sostenibile.
- Promuoviamo l'apprendimento permanente attraverso una varietà di opportunità di formazione e perfezionamento, trasferimento interno di conoscenze ed e-learning.
- In consultazione con il tuo manager, ti offriamo orari di lavoro flessibili entro l'orario di lavoro applicabile, nonché l'opportunità di lavorare occasionalmente da remoto.
- Oltre ai giorni festivi legali e cantonali concediamo giorni liberi aggiuntivi, che vengono definiti annualmente.
- Sosteniamo i dipendenti con responsabilità familiari, tra l'altro, con congedi per l'altro genitore, congedi per adozione e assistenza retribuita per parenti e figli secondo la normativa.
- Vi offriamo un ambiente internazionale a Reinach con circa 1.600 dipendenti, oltre 52 nazionalità e un'anzianità media di servizio di 10 anni.

Contatto
Per candidarti ti chiediamo di caricare i tuoi documenti sulla nostra pagina delle carriere.

Purtroppo le candidature che ci pervengono via e-mail non possono essere prese in considerazione per motivi di protezione dei dati.

Si pregano agenzie, fornitori di servizi del personale o aziende simili di astenersi dall'inviare profili e richieste di possibili collaborazioni non richiesti. Al momento non stiamo lavorando con fornitori di servizi esterni per questa posizione. Tutte le candidature non richieste provenienti dai fornitori di servizi non verranno prese in considerazione e verranno eliminate senza ulteriore esame. Ti ringraziamo per la comprensione.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descriptif
Chez Endress+Hauser, le progrès passe par la collaboration. En tant que premier fournisseur mondial d'instruments de mesure, nos plus de 18 000 collaborateurs façonnent l'avenir dans le domaine de l'automatisation des processus. Qu'il s'agisse d'innover et de mettre en œuvre de nouvelles technologies en équipe, de collaborer au développement de nouveaux appareils ou de renforcer des relations clés avec diverses industries mondiales, notre travail est basé sur l'établissement de relations de confiance qui aident chacun à réussir. En tant qu'entreprise familiale, nous regardons au-delà des objectifs à court terme et travaillons à créer une vision d'avenir pour nos collaborateurs, nos clients et le monde en général.

Nous recherchons un ingénieur en automatisation (logiciel machine et connectivité) 100 % (h/f/d) qui réfléchit ensemble aux logiciels machine (PLC) et à la connectivité machine et veille à ce que les exigences soient claires, testables et conformes aux normes dans leur mise en œuvre.

Chez Flowtec AG à Reinach, en tant que centre de produits, nous développons des technologies de mesure de débit et des solutions pour l'automatisation des processus. Environ 1 600 collaborateurs de plus de 52 nationalités travaillent sur notre site de Reinach. Endress+Hauser Flowtech AG est représentée sur six sites dans le monde et compte plus de 2 900 employés.

De quoi parle le poste?

Vous ne voulez pas seulement « rechercher les erreurs », mais vous souhaitez également ancrer la qualité dès le début du cycle de vie? Connaissez-vous les processus des machines, la logique API et la connectivité (y compris OPC UA), êtes-vous en mesure de structurer clairement les exigences et, en collaboration avec des partenaires externes, pouvez-vous mettre en service de manière fiable une large gamme de systèmes de machines? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit: dans ce rôle, vous combinerez le développement de logiciels, l'ingénierie des exigences pour les logiciels des machines et l'ingénierie de la connectivité des machines. De la spécification au FAT/SAT et à la mise en service.

Tâches
Vous allez:

- Structurer et spécifier les exigences: Travailler en collaboration avec les spécialistes, les opérateurs et la direction de projet sur les logiciels et les processus pour les machines (sous forme de modèles d'état, de définitions d'interface, de spécifications de commandes, de gestion des erreurs/exceptions, de flux de séquences et de processus, de définitions de limites et de gestion des tests).
- Effectuer des revues sur site, entreprendre le débogage et les ajustements sélectifs ou le support des prototypes des logiciels de la machine avec un accompagnement sur tout le cycle de vie des produits et des machines
- Développer des modèles standard OPC UA et des modèles d'informations pour l'intégration des machines, les maintenir cohérents, examiner de manière professionnelle les implémentations des fournisseurs et vérifier la conformité aux normes, y compris la cartographie et l'intégration.
- Diriger professionnellement les fabricants de machines externes: mettre en place et demander des alignements, des révisions et un système de gestion de la qualité
- Planifier, réaliser et documenter les tests FAT/SAT et d'intégration, ainsi que gérer les boucles de correction itératives avec les fournisseurs
- Assurer la stabilité de bout en bout et les garde-fous de sécurité OT (certificats, politiques, protection d'accès, contrôle qualité, documentation)

Exigences
Vous:

- Avoir un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en technologie de l'automatisation, en ingénierie des systèmes, en génie électrique ou une qualification comparable
- Avoir de l'expérience dans le développement d'automates selon la norme CEI 61131-3 et comprendre très bien l'automatisation, la logique des automates et les processus machine avec des séquences, des états et des modèles d'erreurs
- Avoir une expérience pratique dans le développement de concepts d'automates et dans l'architecture de systèmes automates, idéalement avec les machines à états, les modes de fonctionnement, les tests et le dépannage structuré
- Travailler en ingénierie des exigences de manière structurée, testable et orientée cible et avoir idéalement une expérience dans l'environnement machine ou OT
- Avoir un savoir-faire en OPC UA, en communication industrielle et modélisation d'interfaces ainsi qu'une expérience en FAT/SAT et en gestion technique des fournisseurs
- Communiquer en toute confiance en allemand et en anglais et aimer travailler dans plusieurs départements de construction électrique et mécanique ainsi qu'avec d'autres participants au projet

Nous offrons
- Nous sommes une entreprise familiale avec un grand engagement et une vision durable.
- Nous promouvons l'apprentissage tout au long de la vie à travers une variété d'opportunités de formation et de perfectionnement, le transfert de connaissances interne et l'apprentissage en ligne.
- En concertation avec votre manager, nous vous proposons des horaires de travail flexibles dans le cadre des horaires de travail applicables ainsi que la possibilité de travailler occasionnellement à distance.
- En plus des jours fériés légaux et cantonaux, nous accordons des jours de congé supplémentaires, définis annuellement.
- Nous accompagnons les salariés ayant des responsabilités familiales avec, entre autres, un congé pour l'autre parent, un congé d'adoption et une garde rémunérée des proches et des enfants conformément à la réglementation.
- Nous vous proposons à Reinach un environnement international avec environ 1.600 collaborateurs, plus de 52 nationalités et une ancienneté moyenne de 10 ans.

Contacter
Pour postuler, nous vous demandons de télécharger vos documents sur notre page carrières.

Malheureusement, les candidatures qui nous parviennent par email ne peuvent être prises en compte pour des raisons de protection des données.

Les agences, prestataires de services de personnel ou entreprises similaires sont priés de s'abstenir d'envoyer des profils et des demandes de renseignements non sollicités concernant une éventuelle collaboration. Nous ne travaillons actuellement pas avec des prestataires de services externes pour ce poste. Toutes les candidatures non sollicitées émanant de prestataires de services ne seront pas prises en compte et seront supprimées sans autre examen. Nous vous remercions de votre compréhension.

• diriger, développer et positionner le service de communication technique avec environ 15 employés comme un centre de compétence central au sein de l'entreprise.

• façonner la transformation de la documentation technique classique en un contenu modulaire, évolutive et la gestion de l'information.

• responsable de l'introduction et du développement de systèmes modernes de gestion du contenu ainsi que des processus et des rôles associés.

• Assurer une information uniforme, de haute qualité et conforme à la réglementation sur les produits, les variantes, les langues et les canaux.

• contrôler et développer activement la coopération avec la gestion des produits, l'ingénierie, le service, la réglementation et les TI.

• Utiliser la numérisation, les données et l'IA de manière ciblée pour accroître durablement l'efficacité et l'évolutivité de la gestion du contenu et de l'information.

Qu'attendons-nous de vous ?

• avoir un diplôme en génie, sciences naturelles, communication, informatique ou administration d'entreprise avec une référence de numérisation ou une qualification comparable.

• apporter plusieurs années d'expérience dans la communication technique, la gestion du contenu ou l'information sur les produits ainsi que l'expérience de leadership.

• avoir une connaissance approfondie de la documentation structurée (p. ex. normes basées sur le XML comme DITA), du cycle de vie du contenu, des systèmes de gestion du contenu et des processus de publication.

• avoir de l'expérience dans l'environnement industriel ainsi que dans le développement des organisations, des processus et des paysages de systèmes.

• diriger comme une personnalité intégrative, réfléchie, construire la confiance et contrôler les processus de changement en toute sécurité et efficacement.

• penser en réseau, agir de manière pragmatique et convaincre par la communication ainsi que par l'interaction sécurisée avec les parties prenantes internationales.

Qu'attendez-vous de nous ?

• Nous sommes une entreprise familiale avec un grand engagement et une vision durable.

• Ils jouent un rôle clé avec un impact stratégique élevé dans un environnement mondial.

• Nous offrons de nombreuses possibilités de façonner activement la transformation numérique.

• Nous encourageons l'apprentissage tout au long de la vie par la formation, le transfert de connaissances et l'apprentissage en ligne.

• Nous soutenons des modèles de travail flexibles et un équilibre sain entre le travail et la vie personnelle.

• Vous travaillez dans un réseau international avec des interfaces passionnantes et des opportunités de développement.

Comment postuler ?

Pour postuler, nous vous demandons de télécharger vos documents sur notre page carrière. Les demandes qui nous sont envoyées par e-mail ne peuvent malheureusement pas être considérées pour des raisons de protection des données.

On demande aux agences, aux fournisseurs de services au personnel ou à des entreprises semblables de s'abstenir de transmettre des profils et des demandes non sollicités. Nous ne travaillons pas actuellement avec des fournisseurs de services externes pour ce poste. Toutes les demandes non sollicitées seront supprimées sans autre examen.

Descrizione

In Endress+Hauser il progresso avviene attraverso la collaborazione. In qualità di fornitore leader mondiale di strumenti di misura, i nostri oltre 17.000 dipendenti stanno plasmando il futuro nel campo dell'automazione dei processi. Compiti

- modellare lo sviluppo strategico all'interno del software, stabilire processi e nuovi metodi e svilupparli ulteriormente continuamente.

Requisiti

- possedere un diploma universitario (Master, dottore in scienze tecniche ETH o equivalente) nel campo dell'informatica tecnica, dell'ingegneria elettrica o della tecnologia dell'automazione.

- avere ottima conoscenza ed esperienza nell'uso di C/C++ embedded, nei metodi di sicurezza e robustezza, nelle metriche di qualità del software e nello sviluppo test-driven.

Offriamo

- Promuoviamo l'apprendimento permanente attraverso una varietà di opportunità di formazione e perfezionamento, trasferimento interno di conoscenze ed e-learning.

- Beneficerai di un ambiente di lavoro in cui curiosità tecnologica, apprezzamento e libertà creativa si uniscono.

Description

At Endress+Hauser, progress is achieved through collaboration. As a world leader in measuring instruments, our over 17,000 employees are shaping the future in the field of process automation. Whether in innovation and implementation of new technologies in the team, cooperation in the development of new devices or strengthening important relationships with various global industries, our work is based on building trusting relationships that help everyone to succeed.

As a family-run company, we look beyond short-term goals and work to create a future-oriented vision for our employees, our customers and the world in general.

We are looking for a technical lead embedded C++ SW developer from the industrial sector to complement our team and to shape our software landscape sustainably with your experience and to enrich it technically and humanely.

What is this place about?

Are you someone who likes to take bold technological steps? Are you enjoying forming clear software concepts for tomorrow from ideas? And are you enjoying accompanying others on their way and setting standards together? If you find yourself in it, you will be waiting for a role in which you will be helping shape our future generation of devices and have real influence on technologies that people meet every day around the world.

Tasks

- develop new software concepts, system architectures and processes in the software environment and thus lay the foundations for future device generations. - shape strategic development within the software, establish processes and new methods and continuously develop them. - develop employees professionally through active coaching and mentoring.

- take a central role in the development and maintenance of networks within and outside the company and represent our interests in standardization organisations.

Requirements

- have at least 15 years of experience in the development, architecture and real-time design of embedded systems. - have excellent knowledge and experience in the use of embedded C/C++, in security and robustness methods, in software quality metrics and in test-driven development.

- bring with them sound knowledge from an industrial environment and are familiar with requirements in regulated application areas such as functional safety or metrology. - bring with them experience in group or board work as well as very good English and at least good German knowledge.

We offer

- We are a family business with a great commitment and a sustainable vision. - We promote lifelong learning through a wide range of training and further education opportunities, internal knowledge transfer and e-learning. - We invest in your health – with comprehensive health management. - We support you with company retirement provision and offers for the reconciliation of family and work. - You benefit from a work environment where technological curiosity, appreciation and creative freedom come together.

Contact

In order to apply, we ask you to upload your documents on our career page. Unfortunately, applications sent to us by e-mail cannot be considered for data protection reasons.

Agencies, personnel service providers or similar companies are asked to refrain from the unsolicited transmission of profiles and requests for possible cooperation. We currently do not cooperate with external service providers for this body. All unsolicited applications from service providers are not considered and deleted without further examination. We thank you for your understanding.

At Endress+Hauser, progress is made through collaboration. As a world leader in measuring instruments, our approximately 17,000 employees are shaping the future in the field of process automation. Whether in innovation and implementation of new technologies in the team, cooperation in the development of new devices or strengthening important relationships with various global industries, our work is based on building trusting relationships that help everyone to succeed.

As a family-run company, we look beyond short-term goals and work to create a future-oriented vision for our employees, our customers and the world in general.

We are looking for an intern in the field of decision support for second and multi-sourcing in strategic electronics purchasing to complement our global team and further develop our strategic electronics purchasing with new perspectives, data understanding and practical decision-making approaches. In this role, you contribute to making decisions in purchasing more transparent, sound and future-oriented.

What's the job about?

You want to understand how second and multi-sourcing decisions are made in strategic electronics purchasing? You enjoy structuring complex relationships and deriving clear decision-making bases from them? You want to help secure the supply of electronic components in a global company sustainably? Then you will find an exciting internship in which you work analytically, gain practical insights into strategic purchasing and make a visible contribution to ky supply chains.

What tasks will you take on?

You'll be:

• analyze today's approach to assessing and releasing second and multi-sourcing options and derive potential for improvement.

• develop a comprehensible set of criteria with weighting, minimum requirements and decision-making logic.

• Develop a practical evaluation model, for example as an Excel or Dashboard prototype to support decision-making.

• use selected real examples from the electronic purchasing process to validate the model and draw concrete recommendations for action for the application.

• actively participate in DLPE benchmark campaigns, as well as in RFQ and award processes.

• support exchanges with suppliers and internal interfaces, thus contributing to sound purchasing decisions.

What do we expect from you?

You:

• Scattered industrial engineering, business administration, supply chain management, industrial engineering or a similar field of study.

• Ideally, it brings with it a focus on strategic purchasing, supply chain management, operations management, technology management, electronics or data analytics.

• Works in a analytical and structured manner and is interested in electronic components, procurement markets, purchasing and supplier processes.

• Enjoy data analysis and process design and communicate safely with different interfaces in German and English.

• has very good MS Office skills, especially in Excel; initial experience with SAP, Power BI or comparable analysis and reporting tools is an advantage.

• You work carefully and independently, are flexible, responsible, ready to learn, open to new things and have a fast understanding.

What can you expect from us?

• We are a family-run, committed company with a sustainable vision.

• We promote lifelong learning with diverse training and further education opportunities, internal knowledge transfer and e-learning.

• We support work-life balance with flexible working hours.

• We offer support in sustainable mobility solutions such as public transport.

How do you apply?

To apply, please upload your documents on our career page. Unfortunately, applications sent to us by e-mail cannot be considered for data protection reasons.

Agencies, personnel service providers or similar companies are asked to refrain from the unsolicited transmission of profiles and requests for possible cooperation. We currently do not cooperate with external service providers for this body. All unsolicited applications from service providers are not considered and deleted without further examination. We thank you for your understanding.

Dans ce rôle, vous contribuerez à rendre les décisions d’achat plus transparentes, fondées et tournées vers l’avenir.

En quoi consiste le travail ?

Souhaitez-vous comprendre comment les décisions de seconde main et de multi-sourcing sont prises en matière d'achat stratégique d'électronique ? Aimez-vous structurer des relations complexes et en tirer une base claire pour prendre des décisions ? Voulez-vous contribuer à sécuriser durablement l’approvisionnement en composants électroniques dans une entreprise mondiale ? Ensuite, un stage passionnant vous attend au cours duquel vous travaillerez de manière analytique, obtiendrez des informations pratiques sur les achats stratégiques et apporterez une contribution visible à des chaînes d'approvisionnement résilientes.

• analyser la procédure actuelle d'évaluation et de publication des options de deuxième et multi-sourcing et en déduire le potentiel d'amélioration.

• Développer un catalogue compréhensible de critères avec pondération, exigences minimales et logique de décision.

• Participer activement aux campagnes de référence DLPE ainsi qu'aux processus d'appel d'offres et d'approvisionnement.

• Soutenir les échanges avec les fournisseurs et les interfaces internes et contribuer ainsi à des décisions d'achats éclairées.

Qu'attendons-nous de vous ?

Vous :

• étudier le génie industriel, l'administration des affaires, la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, le génie industriel ou un domaine d'études comparable.

• Idéalement, vous vous concentrez sur les achats stratégiques, la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, la gestion des opérations, la gestion technologique, l'électronique ou l'analyse de données.

• Travailler de manière analytique et structurée et s'intéresser aux composants électroniques, aux marchés d'approvisionnement ainsi qu'aux processus d'achat et de fournisseurs.

• Vous appréciez l'analyse des données et la conception de processus et communiquez en toute confiance en utilisant diverses interfaces en allemand et en anglais.

• avoir de très bonnes compétences en MS Office, notamment Excel ; Une première expérience avec SAP, Power BI ou des outils d'analyse et de reporting comparables est un avantage.

• travaillent avec soin et autonomie, sont flexibles, responsables, désireux d'apprendre, ouverts à de nouvelles choses et comprennent rapidement.

At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, with over 18,000 employees, we shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with our global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.

We are looking for an Assistant to join us and provide high-level administrative and strategic support to the Chief Operating Officer (COO) and Chief Technical Officer (CTO) at Endress+Hauser Group Services AG. In this role, you will be part of our Group’s global headquarters in Reinach, Switzerland, supporting the COO and CTO in driving global and ensuring seamless coordination across the executive team.

What is the role about?

Are you organized, proactive, and comfortable managing a wide range of executive-level responsibilities? Do you thrive on creating structure in an international environment? Are you skilled at anticipating needs and finding solutions before others notice the challenge?

If so, this role is your opportunity to play a vital part in supporting our global leadership. You’ll work directly with the COO and CTO, coordinating across international teams, Executive Board members, and key partners — ensuring the smooth execution of operational and administrative activities within a dynamic and collaborative corporate environment.

Which tasks will you perform?

You will:

• Assist the COO and CTO in all aspects of his administrative, commercial, and relational tasks, both internally and externally.

• Proactively manage the agendas in the short and medium term, organizing and coordinating meetings, trips, and events in alignment with other Executive Board members.

• Manage correspondence by prioritizing and responding to emails, ensuring timely communication and efficient information flow.

• Coordinate all travel arrangements, including bookings, documentation, and schedules, ensuring all details are prepared well in advance.

• Support in reporting activities by collecting data from various sources, creating source documents, and preparing monthly reports based on business process system analysis.

• Collaborate closely with other assistants and corporate teams to ensure smooth communication and event organization.

What do we expect from you?

You:

• Hold a degree or equivalent education as an Executive Assistant.

• Are fluent in both German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Bring proven experience supporting senior executives in an international environment, ideally with a track record of supporting multiple executives simultaneously.

• Demonstrate excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, with a high level of professionalism and discretion in handling confidential information.

• Are proficient with Microsoft 365 and modern collaborations tools. Familiarity with business systems such as Business Warehouse and AI is an advantage.

• A strong digital mindset, curiosity for new tools and the ability to quickly learn and apply new software are essential.

• Show strong self-management, initiative, and the ability to work independently while being a collaborative team player.

At Endress+Hauser, progress is made through collaboration. As the world’s leading provider of measuring instruments, our more than 18,000 employees are shaping the future in the field of process automation. Whether it’s innovating and implementing new technologies in a team, working together to develop new devices or strengthening important relationships with different global industries, our work is based on building trusted relationships that help everyone succeed. As a family-run company, we look beyond short-term goals and work to create a future-oriented vision for our employees, our customers and the world in general.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a technically savvy and service-oriented personality as a product + application specialist / support technician.

What is this point about?

Are you excited about analysing technical issues and finding sustainable solutions together with customers and internal specialists? Does your strength lie in explaining technical connections in a comprehensible way and providing competent support to customers in the application of our products? Do you like working at the interface between customer, service organization and our international product centers?

Then you could be exactly the person we are looking for. In this varied function, you support our customers and internal contacts in technical issues relating to our measurement and automation solutions and make an important contribution to a high level of customer satisfaction.

What tasks will you take on?

They shall:

• Advise customers and internal contacts on technical issues related to products, applications, commissioning, faults and complaints.

• analyse technical problems and develop sustainable solutions together with internal and external bodies.

• Process, document and track service cases and technical inquiries as part of case management.

• support our service organization as well as the service technicians in the indoor and outdoor service.

• contribute to the maintenance and development of knowledge management and share technical know-how within the organisation.

• work closely with customers, product centers, sales and other internal departments.

What do we expect from you?

See also:

• have completed technical vocational training in the field of electrical engineering, automation, mechatronics, mechanical engineering or a comparable discipline.

• have ideally completed technical training (HF, TS or comparable).

• bring several years of professional experience in a technical environment, preferably in measuring, control and control technology or industrial automation.

• have strong skills for technical problem analysis and solution finding.

• Convincing thanks to your communication strength, service orientation and structured working method.

• work independently, responsibly and keep track of complex issues.

• have very good knowledge of German and English, French is an advantage

What can you expect from us?

• We are a family-run company with great commitment and a sustainable vision.

• We promote lifelong learning through a wide range of education and training opportunities, internal knowledge transfer and e-learning.

• We value work-life balance and offer flexible working hours and the ability to work remotely to help our employees maintain a healthy balance.

• We place great emphasis on the well-being of our employees by providing them with comprehensive occupational pensions and access to health services that promote the overall well-being of our employees.

• We support family-friendly concepts, including daycare and holiday childcare, to help our employees reconcile their professional and family commitments.

How do you apply?

To apply, we ask you to upload your documents to our career page.
Applications that reach us by e-mail cannot be considered for data protection reasons.
